exact_title: Cefazolin Dialytic Clearance by High-Efficiency and High-Flux Hemodialyzers
source_type: multicenter open-label pharmacokinetic study with population simulations
date_or_version: April 2001 article with May 2001 appended erratum
reference_pages: references begin on journal page 775 and continue through 776

tables.title: Population Simulation of the Cefazolin Serum Concentration Versus Time Curves in the High-Efficiency and High-Flux Groups

appendices_or_supplements.reason: Corrects parameter designations in pharmacokinetic equations 1 and 2.

coverage_decision: All 13 PDF pages were rendered and visually scanned. Both figures and all four tables were reconciled. The bibliography was extracted to a separate task queue and not atomized. The erratum was included because it changes the model description.
omissions: Individual subject rows from Tables 1-3 are not repeated verbatim in the SEA HTML. The structured table blocks preserve design, group means, inferential statistics, and interpretation. Full individual rows remain in the primary PDF.
integrity_findings: The Results section reports P = 0.4517 for systemic clearance in nonoliguric versus remaining high-efficiency subjects, while the Discussion reports P = 0.34 for the same 3.32 versus 2.79 mL/min comparison. The discrepancy was retained and not corrected.
The appended erratum corrects parameter-designation errors in equations 1 and 2 of the pharmacokinetic model description.
external_verification: Not performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
